protocol.study: S2 controlled interactions and S3 three-seed CPU comparison
protocol.hypervolume_policy: configured trials plus fixed anchor (1,1); discard points outside reference box; exclude Stored and references
protocol.finalists: union of per-study speed, size and compromise roles frozen on training before validation; include production/reference controls and prior synthetic winners as regression sentinels
protocol.memory_cases: largest real validation file and largest synthetic validation case, selected by size before measuring
protocol.memory_scope: single encode process peak RSS including input/output/runtime and file I/O, excluding decoders and timing loops; separate from encode timings
protocol.promotion: none; real holdout was previously visible and is regression evidence
protocol.gpu_decision: bound the gain available from measured CPU proposal/feedback overhead; do not infer a trained GPU surrogate result

source_provenance: measured working-tree files include uncommitted research tooling; source_sha256 identifies the measured revision, not the parent commit alone

corpus.test_policy: 14 original full synthetic cases reserved; no real final test in this study
corpus.validation_policy: previously visible full real holdout plus larger synthetic validation; regression only

finalists.selection: training only; no validation feedback or production promotion

default_equivalent_control.interpretation: finite output equality witness; timing differences are policy representation/codegen or noise, not different search settings

memory.scope: single native encode process, includes runtime/input/output and file I/O; no decoder or timing loop

limitations: real holdout was visible previously; regression evidence only
the finite seed/evaluation budget is a bounded pilot, not global optimality
unique evaluation budgets are equal; elapsed time is reported, not a matched wall-time stop budget
training uses mixed 256 KiB regimes/chunks; validation uses full real files
bootstrap resamples workload groups and paired rounds; not a guarantee for unmeasured workloads
RSS measures whole encode processes on two cases, not all-trial allocation or a third optimized objective
optimizer replacement bound applies to timed CPU setup/proposals/feedback; no trained GPU model measured
no production preset promotion or fresh final test
